item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We state this plainly: smoking a pack a day for 30 years raises a person’s risk of lung cancer many times over. Long-term smoking has deadly consequences. Prevention and quitting matter.

2. We will not soften the truth about tobacco. If a person smokes a pack a day for 30 years, their risk of lung cancer will rise many times over. The sooner someone quits, the better.

3. We know decades of daily smoking carry a devastating cost. A pack a day for 30 years multiplies a person’s risk of lung cancer many times over. We must prevent tobacco use and support people ready to quit.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 108 words

We know that smoking a pack a day for 30 years drives the risk of lung cancer many times higher. That is not an abstract statistic; it is a warning about what prolonged tobacco use does to human lives. We refuse to soften the truth: every year of smoking adds danger, and decades of exposure carry devastating consequences. Prevention matters, quitting matters, and clear information matters. We will keep speaking plainly so people can protect their health, support loved ones who want to quit, and demand communities where fewer people are exposed to tobacco. The message is urgent and unequivocal: long-term smoking multiplies the risk of lung cancer.
